title: US bill aiming to boost clean energy could backfire | New Scientist
description: The Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act is a gamble that speeding up permits for energy projects would help renewables more than fossil fuels – but many environmentalists have doubts
author: Alec Luhn

title: Anthropic mathematician claims AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis | New Scientist
description: The Riemann hypothesis is one of the most difficult problems in mathematics, having stood for 167 years. It may have just been settled with the help of AI
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: US, Russia and China look set to block ban on autonomous weapons | New Scientist
description: More than 70 countries are ready to begin negotiations on prohibiting lethal autonomous weapons, but large militarised nations are expected to obstruct efforts to agree a ban
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Unexpected stone tools from Israel raise questions about cultural evolution | New Scientist
description: Ancient humans in the eastern Mediterranean first began producing advanced stone blades 100,000 years before the tools became widely used, indicating that new technologies weren't automatically adopted by communities
author: Benjamin Taub

title: The BepiColombo spacecraft is finally entering orbit around Mercury | New Scientist
description: After an eight-year voyage towards the sun, the BepiColombo spacecraft can finally begin its mission to unpick the many mysteries of our solar system's smallest planet
author: Leah Crane

title: Huge extinct orca may have eaten other whales | New Scientist
description: A nearly 8-metre-long species of orca lived in the North Sea over 2 million years ago. Its discovery suggests orcas evolved a diet of marine mammals earlier than scientists thought
author: Jake Buehler
